name: Burndown
description: Native Drupal agile/Kanban project management: projects, tasks, sprints, swimlane boards, backlog, and burndown charts.
project_description: Burndown is a native Drupal agile project-management tool. It provides Projects, Tasks, Sprints and Columns (swimlanes) as Drupal entities, with drag-and-drop Kanban and Sprint boards, a backlog, a completed board, task work logs and comments, task relationships (blocked by / child of / etc.), watchlists, email notifications, and burndown charts. Projects and Tasks are fieldable entity bundles so they can be extended like any other Drupal content. Estimation supports T-shirt, geometric and dot sizing. It ships a per-project permission model, a large library of Drush commands, and two navigation blocks (a project 'cloud' and a sidebar nav). The optional burndown_time_tracker submodule adds start/stop task timers and an hours report. Requires only modern Drupal core modules (datetime, field, image, link, options, taxonomy, views) - no external services.
